Date: Sat, 03 Apr 2027 15:12:00 -0700
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Luke Harris <luke.harris@medstream.io>, Procurement <procurement@medstream.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Subject: Post-call recap: infra constraints that drive Private vs Dedicated

Hi Luke / procurement team,

Thanks again for the call earlier — good conversation and appreciate the clarity on PHI scope. Quick recap and a few targeted asks so we can size the right path (Hosted API vs Dedicated vs Private VPC).

Summary from our side:
- Primary driver: handling PHI for patient records in production; procurement leaned toward Private VPC to meet isolation controls.
- Identity: you currently use Okta. Need to confirm if you require SAML SSO only or prefer OIDC flows for app integration.
- Keys: you mentioned 'customer-managed keys' — please confirm if BYOK with HSM-backed keys is mandatory for data-at-rest encryption, or if KMS with external key-wrapping is acceptable.
- Logging/retention: you called out long-term audit retention. Can you confirm target retention (months/years) and whether logs must be exported to your SIEM/archival store?

Asks / next steps we need from you to recommend a deployment pattern and draft SOW:
1) Confirm SSO protocol preference (SAML 2.0 vs OIDC) and whether SCIM user provisioning will be required.
2) Confirm KMS requirement: BYOK + HSM (CloudHSM/HSM appliance) required? Any vendor constraints (AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault, on-prem HSM)?
3) Log retention target and whether logs must remain inside your VPC or can be forwarded to an external tenant.
4) Any corporate compliance artifacts (SOC 2, HIPAA BAAs) you'd like attached to the SOW / procurement packet.

Proposed timeline:
- If answers above indicate Private required: propose a 4-6 week Private POC (network, KMS integration, test workloads).
- If Dedicated meets requirements (BYOK via AWS KMS + VPC peering) we can target a 2-3 week pilot.

Can you reply with the three items above by end of day Monday 2027-04-05? I can then loop in Marissa to build an integration estimate and Markus for commercial sizing.

Attachments referenced: MedStream_Security_QA.pdf (attachment stub)

Thanks,
Priyom
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwoodinference.com

Subject: Re: Post-call recap: infra constraints that drive Private vs Dedicated

Priyom, thanks for the clear recap. Quick answers inline.

1) SSO: We primarily use Okta. Our security team prefers OIDC for new service integrations, but SAML compatibility is required for some legacy apps. SCIM would be a nice-to-have, not mandatory for the pilot.

2) Keys: BYOK is required. We need HSM-backed keys. For cloud, we prefer AWS KMS with CloudHSM. If you support a hosted key-wrapping model that still uses our HSM for root key material, we could consider it, but priority is that our keys are customer-controlled.

3) Logs: Retention target is 5 years for normal logs; 7 years for audit trails related to PHI access. Logs must be exportable to our SIEM (Splunk) and we prefer a direct sink from the deployment into our VPC.

4) Compliance artifacts: please attach your SOC 2 Type II report and your standard BAA.

Procurement note: based on our security posture, Private VPC looks like the conservative path but we are open to Dedicated if the KMS/HSM constraints are fully satisfied and logs can be kept inside our VPC.

I attached a short security Q&A we use internally (see stub). Happy to jump on a follow-up call — 10am PT Tue 2027-04-06 works for our team.

Regards,
Luke Harris
Director of Security Ops, MedStream
luke.harris@medstream.io
